authorized_group_ids.description: QQ groups allowed to run the agent
authorized_group_ids.hint: Empty disables autonomous runs. Add QQ group IDs as strings; * enables every group.

direct_delay_seconds.description: Quiet delay when the bot is mentioned

renderer.description: Context renderer for newly assigned conversations
renderer.hint: Aggregated Delta Block (Dash-separated) uses one user message wrapped in <group_messages_delta> with --- separators; Aggregated Delta Block (Line-separated) joins structured event lines with newlines; Dedicated User Block per Message creates a separate role=user block for each event.

max_messages_per_cycle.description: Maximum new messages in one snapshot
max_messages_per_cycle.hint: 0 keeps the complete unconsumed delta. Older messages remain searchable through tools.

max_text_chars.description: Maximum stored outline length per message

record_self_messages.description: Record messages sent by the bot account
record_self_messages.hint: Enabled bot echo events can enter later snapshots and start another reasoning cycle.

record_empty_messages.description: Record messages with no text or components
record_empty_messages.hint: Contentless transport events are retained for diagnostics and skipped before model inference.

custom_system_prompt.description: Additional persona or group behavior instructions
